title: Taco-Flavor Ground Beef
steps: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and break it up with a spatula.
Stir in the salt, pepper, cumin, red pepper flakes, and garlic. Cook, stirring and breaking up the beef, until it reaches 160°F on a food thermometer.
Taste the cooked beef. Add more seasoning as needed, starting with cumin and salt.
